title: Trump's VA killed a home loan program. Thousands of veterans are paying the price
summary: An NPR investigation finds that more than 15,000 military veterans were put into much-higher-cost home loans after the Trump administration cut a key program. Many now pay $1,000 more per month.
contentText:
An NPR investigation finds that more than 15,000 military veterans were put into much-higher-cost home loans after the Trump administration cut a key program. Many now pay $1,000 more per month.

(Image credit: Maddie McGarvey for NPR)
